title: Lifted Payments Payment Statement Audit Model
description: A processor-neutral, machine-readable model for normalizing monthly merchant payment-processing statements without storing cardholder data. Version 1.1.1 hardens the schema 1.1.0 validator and publication gate against pathological numbers, malformed or traversing manifests, candidate-validator failure, incomplete asset inventories, and credential signatures across every declared release file.
notes: All figures and validation vectors are synthetic and do not describe a real merchant. The model contains no cardholder data. The validation report records 2 accepted valid vectors and 14 correctly rejected invalid vectors. Package 1.1.1 preserves the schema 1.1.0 record contract.
